faqs.a: SVG paths scale infinitely, so any size is equally crisp. For web use, 256–512 px covers retina displays; for favicons or tiny UI, export at exactly the display size (16–64 px).

The path box accepts the contents of an SVG path 'd' attribute (the M/L/C/Z commands). If the artwork uses a different viewBox, results may be offset — the renderer assumes the standard 24×24 icon grid.

icon-to-png-converter.formula:
pad = size x (padding / 100)
content = size - 2 x pad
scale = content / 24
Example: size = 256 px, padding = 10%
pad = 25.6 px, content = 204.8 px, scale = 204.8 / 24 = 8.53
Each icon unit becomes 8.53 px on the canvas.
